_contract: The shot list is a contract (§7A.9): fixed teams, fixed seed, fixed sim-frame timestamp and a fixed camera pose per shot. Same commit + same shot name => the same pixels. Camera poses are in SCENE coords (x along the pitch length, y up, z across the width = sim y). Changing a seed, a frame count or a pose invalidates every baseline captured before it, so treat edits here like an API break.
_teams: cze (red #D7141A) vs ger (white #FFFFFF) everywhere — two maximally distinct kits, and the keeper palette resolves clear of both.

shots.name: midfield_wide
shots.note: Open play, ball just left of the centre circle, both shapes on screen. Broadcast-height wide — the everyday readability shot.

shots.name: goalmouth_scramble
shots.note: Frame 986 of seed 8230: a German shot being struck on the edge of the six with a Czech defender sliding in and the keeper set — 9 bodies inside 14m of the ball. Camera behind the west goal, shooting through the net past the keeper.

shots.name: celebration_closeup
shots.note: Seed 22343 scores at frame 1706 (Goretzka, 1'). 54 frames later he is mid-celebrate at (-46.1, 6.2) under falling confetti — a real goal celebration, not a posed close-up.

shots.name: stadium_establishing
shots.note: The whole bowl from a high corner at night: roof line, three tiers, all four floodlight banks. The venue-scale and floodlight-bloom shot.

shots.name: pitch_stripes_low_sun
shots.note: Knee-height camera raking the full length of the pitch into a low sunset key — the mowing stripes, the goalmouth wear and the grass grain all read at a glancing angle here and nowhere else.

shots.name: specular_bloom_check
shots.note: A player at 6m, backlit by the low sunset key, standing against the pool of sun-raked grass behind him. This is the §7A.6 grey-halo regression test: the bloom must rim the silhouette, not paint a desaturated halo around it.
